root: ^Good evening, sir. I couldn't help but notice you staring.
^Hmm? Me? Staring? If you noticed me staring, wouldn't that mean you also were staring?
^Oh my! You're right, sir. My apologies, mr... Smiley?
^Oh, yes. There are many things here that make me smile.
^The misery of that Rabbit for one.
^But, little lady, it looks like you lost something.
^Oh, no. I am searching for something, but it's not me who lost it.
^Aren't we all searching for something all the time?
^But that's quite boring, I can't help but feel dissapointed.
^Maybe look up for once? Nobody ever looks up.
^Thank you for your advice, Mr. Smiley!
